description: This file implements the 'ThroughputAnalyzer' class, which measures network throughput based on active requests, response sizes, and network conditions. It manages throughput observation windows, handles request lifecycle events, and calculates throughput metrics.

classes.name: ThroughputAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that estimates network throughput by tracking active requests, response sizes, and network conditions, and manages throughput measurement windows.

methods.name: MaybeStartThroughputObservationWindow
methods.description: Starts a throughput measurement window if conditions are met.

methods.name: EndThroughputObservationWindow
methods.description: Ends the current throughput measurement window.

methods.name: IsCurrentlyTrackingThroughput
methods.description: Checks if a throughput measurement window is active.

methods.name: UpdateResponseContentSize
methods.description: Updates the stored response size for a request.

methods.name: NotifyStartTransaction
methods.description: Handles the start of a request, updating internal state and possibly starting measurement.

methods.name: NotifyBytesRead
methods.description: Updates request activity when bytes are read.

methods.name: NotifyRequestCompleted
methods.description: Handles request completion, calculates throughput, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: NotifyExpectedResponseContentSize
methods.description: Updates expected response size for a request.

methods.name: IsHangingWindow
methods.description: Determines if a request is hanging based on received bits and duration.

methods.name: MaybeGetThroughputObservation
methods.description: Attempts to compute and retrieve current throughput measurement.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles network connection type changes, marking requests as degrading accuracy.

methods.name: SetUseLocalHostRequestsForTesting
methods.description: Sets a flag for testing with localhost requests.

methods.name: GetBitsReceived
methods.description: Returns total bits received from network activity.

methods.name: CountActiveInFlightRequests
methods.description: Returns the number of active requests.

methods.name: CountTotalInFlightRequests
methods.description: Returns total number of in-flight requests.

methods.name: CountTotalContentSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns total response content size in bytes.

methods.name: DegradesAccuracy
methods.description: Determines if a request degrades throughput measurement accuracy.

methods.name: BoundRequestsSize
methods.description: Ensures request collections do not exceed maximum size, disabling measurements if exceeded.

methods.name: EraseHangingRequests
methods.description: Removes requests considered hanging based on network conditions.
